You can restart it. To get the best result, we advise you to shake the juicer during operating. 8.Red and blue flashing lights mean your jar isn't aligned with your base. To fix this, the arrow on the jar should line up with the switch on the base. 9.Red flashing lights mean your blender needs to be recharged or that your blades are blocked. Recharge or shake your blender. 10.There might be a little color difference due to the monitor, camera or other factors, please refer to the physical item.
